decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:DWL 01; DWL 02 Location Plan;Proposed Floor Plans; Sections - 2023-09-02; Roof Plans 25.11.2023; and e-mail dated 22.01.2024Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing buildings other than where-so stipulated on the hereby approved plans. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance

Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved and in accordance with the e-mail dated 22.01.2023, prior to development commencing amended plans shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority which demonstrate:i)	 that the windows and doors at ground floor level to the rear and first floor level to the front correspond with the details of windows and doors as shown on the proposed elevation; and.ii)	The proposed roof plan shall be updated to reflect the proposed cross section. Development shall be carried out in accordance with these revised details.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the proposal would provide a satisfactory appearance
description: Part first floor, part two-storey side extension, part single, part 2-storey rear extension, extension to roof incorporating four rear dormers and two storey front extension incorporating a porch entrance.(Amended)
